description: Header file defining the ProcessInfo class and related classes for process management, including process memory stats, process iteration, and process tree functionalities within the WPEFramework::Core namespace.

classes.name: ProcessInfo
classes.description: Represents information about a process, including memory stats, priority, policy, and control methods.

classes.name: ProcessCurrent
classes.description: Derived class providing current process information with user and group details.

classes.name: ProcessTree
classes.description: Represents a process hierarchy starting from a specific process, allowing process containment checks and ID retrieval.

classes.name: Memory
classes.description: Inner class managing memory statistics for a process.

classes.name: Iterator
classes.description: Inner class for iterating over processes, including child processes and process IDs.

methods.name: MemoryStats
methods.description: Retrieve memory statistics for the process.

methods.name: USS
methods.description: Get the USS (Unique Set Size) memory metric.

methods.name: PSS
methods.description: Get the PSS (Proportional Set Size) memory metric.

methods.name: RSS
methods.description: Get the RSS (Resident Set Size) memory metric.

methods.name: VSS
methods.description: Get the VSS (Virtual Set Size) memory metric.

methods.name: Dump
methods.description: Trigger a process dump via SIGFPE signal.
